1st of 16 (promoted) | website = {{URL|https://fknaftagas.com/}} | kit_alt1 = | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FF0000 | body1 = FF0000 | rightarm1 = FF0000 | shorts1 = FF0000 | socks1 = FF0000 | kit_alt2 = | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF }} '''Fudbalski klub Proleter 023''' ([[Serbian Cyrillic alphabet|Serbian Cyrillic]]: Фудбалски клуб Пролетер 023) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Zrenjanin]], [[Serbia]]. The team currently competes in the [[Serbian First League]]. Founded in 1921, the club was known as '''Bratstvo''' after [[World War II]], before changing its name to '''Naftagas''' in the early 1970s.{{cite web |url=https://fknaftagas.com/istorija/ |title=FK Naftagas \ Istorija |website=fknaftagas.com |access-date=14 July 2026}} After winning the 2025–26 [[Serbian League Vojvodina]], the club relocated from Elemir to Zrenjanin and changed its name to '''Proleter 023'''.{{cite web|url=https://zurnal.politika.rs/scc/clanak/251027/fudbal/prva-liga/nikolicu-lepo-u-ravnici|title=Николићу лепо у равници|website=[[Sportski žurnal]]|date=10 July 2026|accessdate=15 July 2026}} The club also has youth categories that participate in the development of young players, including youth, cadet and pioneer selection.{{cite web |url=https://105.rs/fudbalski-klub-naftagas-elemir |title=Fudbalski klub Naftagas Elemir |website=105.rs |access-date=25 May 2026}}"}}
